claims.statement: For BLS12-381 plain G1 ECDLP (bls12-381-g1-ecdlp-plain), on any supplied T = [x]P0 in G1 (uniform x in 0..r-1, including T = infinity for x = 0, with no auxiliary powers), the self-contained (4,3) Q(zeta_15) CM-STNFS + Arch2-Prod 1-owner flat-array build + complete iterative Q32 dsieve16 (2-tier B_int gate) + lossless 60-bit smulh/umulh lower-bound 2-stage BOUND_CELL_LO (uniform <=0.6212b two-sided gap + explicit 2^-24 near-cancellation charge) + deterministic bit-sum knapsack k=1 Boole (coarse-bin linearity-of-expectation H5-Empty, ZERO F_{j-1} ideal conditioning, NO Gate E) + pure-Taylor unit_orbit + proved RET_BOOT=1 + PM-Basis algorithm transfers (P0, T) to G_T via the public pairing e(., Q0) and recovers the 64-hex scalar x with [x]P0 = T with success probability >= 0.39 (opened-run Boole floor >= 0.999655, run gate K = 7196713054750614093) and expected total classical work E[W_G1] <= 1 + (K/2^64)*10*(2^111.498808 + 2^66) < 2^113.462779939644 G1 units (C = 2,000 baseline scalar ARMv8.0-A integer instructions; core rows in C_core = 20,000 = 10 G1 units, unified aborting meter t_run = 2^123.0 core units = 10*2^123.0 G1 units).
